remarks:
Combining modern comfort, peaceful surroundings, and plenty of space to enjoy every season, this beautifully remodeled home sits on 2 acres in Bliss NY, Wyoming County, and features a pond and detached garage.

This A-frame home has been completely remodeled and is located on a peaceful, private lot, making it an ideal full-time residence or seasonal getaway. The home has new electric wiring, new plumbing, a new roof, a fresh interior, and fresh paint on a lot of the decking.

The property is located several hundred feet off the road and is accessed by a deeded driveway. As you enter the property, there is a pond with a new dock and fountain. The front porch overlooks the pond, while the back deck overlooks the fireplace and large lawn. There is also an enclosed netting area on the deck that could be used for eating outside or just enjoying the property.

Inside, the entire house has been remodeled with a new kitchen, appliances, bathroom, and living room. The full bathroom is downstairs, while the bedroom and half bathroom are upstairs. There is also a walkout deck off the upstairs bedroom that gives you a nice view of the property and a peaceful place to enjoy the morning. A new split heater has also recently been installed.

There is a detached 2-car garage for parking and storage. An ATV side-by-side, tractor, riding lawnmower, and two snowmobiles are also negotiable with the property. The storage container on the property stays.

The landowner also receives an annual payment of approximately $2,500 due to the property’s proximity to the windmills.

Overall, this is a unique home that has been completely remodeled and offers a private setting with a pond, garage, large lawn, and plenty of outdoor space. It would make a great place to live year-round or use as a seasonal getaway.

This property is located 10 minutes from Arcade NY, 27 minutes from Warsaw NY, 20 minutes from Rushford Lake and Java Lake, and 1 Hour from Buffalo NY.
